text: Appeal of Order to Comply (May 23, 2018) for 9 Strode Drive.

Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed the order to comply (May 23, 2018) for 9 Strode Drive, Folder No. 18 162938 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to October 31, 2018, to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
